- SCCs: we'll adopt the EU Commission 2021 SCCs and reference a cross-border appendix (we'll not attempt to embed the whole text; we'll reference the SCC clause template and attach the full SCCs as an exhibit).

- TIA: for hosted eu-west-1 usage, recommend short TIA summary in appendix (data flows, export endpoints, subprocessors). We only escalate to full TIA if keys or subprocessors materially store outside the EEA or we propose transfer to US-based infra.

I'll add suggested language for: processor obligations (encryption in transit/at rest), subprocessors, audit rights, export controls, and data subject assistance. Sending a redline and a short checklist by Monday morning so Rafael can consolidate.
